title: athyrium zeylanicum
intro: Athyrium zeylanicum, commonly known as the Ceylon fern, is a species of fern native to Sri Lanka. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in treating wounds, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium zeylanicum include its ability to act as a vulnerary, promoting wound healing, and its sedative effects, which can help in reducing anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
